  docs-check:
    name: Docs Check

    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check docs updated with code changes
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # #356: rebased-aware via merge-base; bypass via [skip-docs] commit token.
          MB=$(git merge-base \"$BASE_SHA\" \"$HEAD_SHA\" || echo \"$BASE_SHA\")
          CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only \"$MB\" \"$HEAD_SHA\")
          LOG=$(git log --format=%B \"$MB..$HEAD_SHA\" || true)

          HAS_CODE=$(echo \"$CHANGED\" | grep -E '^(src/|__tests__/)' || true)
          HAS_DOCS=$(echo \"$CHANGED\" | grep -E '^(docs/|README\\.md)' || true)
          BYPASS=$(echo \"$LOG\" | grep -F '[skip-docs]' || true)

          if [ -n \"$HAS_CODE\" ] && [ -z \"$HAS_DOCS\" ] && [ -z \"$BYPASS\" ]; then
            echo \"::error::Code changed without documentation update\"
            echo \"\"
            echo \"Files changed in src/ or __tests__/:\"
            echo \"$HAS_CODE\"
            echo \"\"
            echo \"Please update docs/ or README.md, or add [skip-docs] to a commit message to bypass.\"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo \"Docs check passed.\"
